definitions.explanation: A product released in a limited quantity or for a limited time. Common for books, games, merchandise, and collectibles.

examples.japanese: {限定版|げんていばん}はすぐ{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The limited edition sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: このゲームの{限定版|げんていばん}には{特典|とくてん}が{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: The limited edition of this game comes with bonus items.

examples.japanese: {限定版|げんていばん}は{通常版|つうじょうばん}より{値段|ねだん}が{高|たか}いが、コレクターには{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Limited editions are more expensive than regular editions, but they are popular with collectors.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {限定|げんてい} (limited) and {版|ばん} (edition). Used across many product categories — games, books, DVDs, figures, and more.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定版|げんていばん} (quantity-limited edition)
- {初回|しょかい}{限定版|げんていばん} (first-run limited edition)
- {限定版|げんていばん}を{予約|よやく}する (to preorder the limited edition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通常版|つうじょうばん}: regular edition — the standard version, as opposed to {限定版|げんていばん}
- {改訂版|かいていばん}: revised edition — an updated version of a publication
